name: VTT
tagline: What it does VTT is a native macOS menu-bar dictation app
description: What it does VTT is a native macOS menu-bar dictation app. A floating bar sits at the bottom of your screen — hit a hotkey, speak, and your words appear at your cursor in any app, without stealing focus. Key benefits - Private on-device transcription by default — audio never leaves your Mac, no account needed - Optional cloud engines (Deepgram, OpenAI, ElevenLabs) via your own API key — great for accents - 26 languages with per-language engine routing and keyboard auto-detection - Auto-insert in
